issues.issue: Result claims the trial was 'reviewed as a superiority trial, failed to demonstrate superiority,' which contradicts the design/population fields stating TOC100224 was a non-inferiority study treated as supportive; the superiority-vs-non-inferiority framing is internally inconsistent.

Stating the study 'failed' misrepresents the citation: the quote says it failed to show SUPERIORITY and still met non-inferiority (difference 4.7%, CI -0.4 to 9.7), so labeling it a failed trial overstates the negative conclusion.
The total '213' is not present in any citation quote (only the component counts 140 and 73 and the ITTC 210 are cited); it is an uncited derived number.
The total '519' is not present in any citation quote (only component counts 346 and 173 are cited); it is an uncited derived number.
False-positive automated flags: 94.8, 345, 90.1, 155, and 172 are all contained in the cited OCR string 'ITTC327/34594.8155/17290.14.7(-0.4, 9.7)' and are adequately supported.
False-positive flags: the numbers 12 and 2006 are part of the receipt date (June 12, 2006), which is a date and excluded from uncited-number scrutiny.
False-positive flag: '275833' is a compound/drug code (SB-275833), not an efficacy/safety number, and appears throughout cited quotes.
Comparator (cephalexin 6.6%, 54/819) and placebo values are included; they are cited and explicitly labeled 'for context,' so acceptable but worth noting they are not the subject drug's rates.
